documents.title: All Machines — Fleet Safety Compliance Summary Q1 2026
documents.content: Factory Fleet Safety Compliance Summary Q1 2026. Monthly safety audits conducted by Safety Officer D. Mehta on 15th of each month for all zones. FLEET TOTAL: 30 safety checks conducted. 30 passed. Fleet safety compliance rate: 100.0%. All machines passed monthly audit on 2026-03-15. Key findings from March audit: PPE compliance 100% in all zones. All emergency stops functional. All pressure vessels within certified limits. LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) procedure compliance confirmed for all machines requiring it. No lost-time injuries (LTI) recorded in Q1 2026. Zero reportable safety incidents.
